implementation: Readable handwritten C99 Gauss-Kronrod quadrature and depth-first dyadic refinement; original fifteen-digit BCD arithmetic, no CPU or ROM execution and no host floating-point substitute

implemented_routines.name: weighted accumulation
implemented_routines.scope: Decimal callback value times stored quadrature weight, then ordered scalar addition

implemented_routines.name: symmetric callback pair
implemented_routines.scope: Original node-times-halfwidth, subtraction/negation, left/right callback order and per-pair cleanup

implemented_routines.name: embedded Gauss-Kronrod rule
implemented_routines.scope: Seven Gauss and fifteen Kronrod points, original ROM node/weight records, seven cancellation polls and finite-decimal error estimate

implemented_routines.name: relative tolerance gate
implemented_routines.scope: Absolute tolerance-times-integral scale, minimum1e-10, thirteen-digit numeric comparison and scale-overflow acceptance

implemented_routines.name: adaptive integration driver
implemented_routines.scope: Prepared real callback API, default1e-5 and negative toleranceF8, endpoint checks, repeated initial interval, ordered dyadic refinement, nativeF1/F3/FB and final cleanup; parser prefix/bound contract documented separately

callback_contract: Local X follows native0x171ea order. Legacy zero+F means evaluation failure; positive named OK/ERROR distinguishes native condition from successful F-valued variables. Midpoint arithmetic gates and surviving rich raw-record scalar interpretation are preserved. The parser owns native globalX save/restore and actual bank cleanup.
gaps: Standalone module does not parse expression tokens
Complex callbacks and malformed BCD are excluded
Reset/keyscan execution is outside the prepared native oracle
completion: Prepared real adaptive quadrature only; complete firmware equivalence remains unproven
